questions.label: What should Search Projects search in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: projects and chat threads. Your original wording said basic search through chat threads, but a project search should also find project names/paths for navigation.
options: Projects, chat threads, and file names

questions.label: How should search results appear?
questions.help: Recommended: center-screen takeover with an X close button, matching the original task list.
options: Center-screen takeover with X close button

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether results include missing projects, removed projects, file content, attachments, archived/deleted chats, or cross-workspace project chats.
